jobs.name: momentum_x1_momo_machine
jobs.prompt: On warm cream cardstock, hex #F2EFE9, with fine paper grain: at left, a blue sphere mascot, hex #1255B2, with a flat bottom, two vertical white oval eyes set wide, and a thin blue antenna capped with a small yellow bead #F5C43C, satin plastic, looking up and to the right. At right, a folded royal blue cardstock polyhedron, hex #0A3498, its panels joined by small polished gold beads, hex #FACD00, roughly twice the mascot's size, resting on the same surface. Both cast soft drop shadows from a soft top-left light. Generous empty cream above. No text, no logo.

jobs.name: momentum_x2_paper_city
jobs.prompt: A scale model of a neoclassical museum with a wide columned facade and broad front steps, entirely folded from royal blue cardstock, hex #0A3498, with white-tipped fold edges, standing on warm cream cardstock, hex #F1EDE4. Perched on the roof's centre is a small flat blue disc mascot, hex #1F75FE, with a white ring inside its rim, one thin single-curl antenna, two large glossy black oval eyes and a tiny smile. Soft studio key from the right, long soft shadows to the left, fine paper grain, generous empty cream sky above. No text, no logo, no people.

jobs.name: momentum_x3_the_fold
jobs.prompt: Top-down on warm cream cardstock, hex #FDF9F3, with fine grain: a row of six triangular royal blue cardstock panels, hex #0A3498, lying flat and unfolded, edge to edge like an open net, each vertex holding a small polished gold bead, hex #FACD00, and a single thin gold cable threaded through all six beads in a straight line across the frame. Matte paper with visible crease lines where each panel will fold. Soft top-left light, soft shadows. Empty cream above and below the row. No text, no logo.

jobs.name: momentum_x5_particles_dark
jobs.prompt: A deep navy-black field, hex #071421, with faint fine grain. Thousands of tiny glowing particles, most in electric blue #3897CC and a few in gold #FACD00, drift through the dark with depth of field, near ones soft and large, far ones sharp and small. They are gathering: densest in a perfect circular cluster at centre frame about one third of the frame height, thinning outward into loose scattered drift toward the edges. The cluster is a dense ring of particles with a slightly sparser centre. No shapes, no letters, no logo, no light rays, no lens flare. Cinematic, macro, dark.

jobs.name: momentum_x6_particles_cream
jobs.prompt: A warm cream cardstock field, hex #FDF9F3, with fine paper grain. Thousands of tiny matte particles in royal blue #0A3498 and a few in gold #FACD00, like fine confetti or ink specks with soft shadows, scattered across the paper and gathering into a perfect circular cluster at centre frame about one third of the frame height, densest at the ring, thinning outward into loose scatter. Soft top-left light, slight depth of field. No shapes, no letters, no logo, no glow.

jobs.name: momentum_x4_page_writes
jobs.prompt: Top-down close-up on warm beige watercolour paper, hex #EFECE6: a single thick paper-and-clay phone card, upright and slightly angled, fills the centre of frame. Its face shows a small burnt-orange pill button, hex #D06214, near the top and below it seven rows of light grey placeholder bars, hex #D1D5DB, of varying widths, evenly spaced. Matte and tactile, soft-edged drop shadow, soft top-left light. Empty beige on both sides. No legible text.
